releaseNotes:
🔴 YouTube Music Integration: Stream & search YouTube playlists and tracks directly in the app.
🎤 Smoother Lyrics: Fixed sentence dip/bounce, natural vocal cutoff timing, and freeze-free crossfade.
⏭️ Responsive Skip Controls: Fixed unresponsive >> (Skip Next) button during crossfade & rapid taps.
🔍 Search Tab Fixes: Resolved voice search crashes, search suggestion enter-key bug, and query lag.
⚡ Silky Smooth 120FPS: Removed heavy FBO rendering and fixed playback crashes for maximum performance.
